chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

key_terms.السِّوَاكُ: tooth-cleaning with the siwak; oral cleansing
key_terms.الْوُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution), the ritual washing before worship
key_terms.شَطْرُ: half; indicating great significance and proportion

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام say about siwak and wudu?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the importance of siwak as a significant part of ritual cleanliness. It highlights oral hygiene as closely connected to wudu (ablution) and the etiquette of worship.
